blurb: Sun-Oka Beach Provincial Park offers frontcountry camping within 1 km of a highway or park road. Campsites include regular and double sites with parking for vehicles. Camping fees vary seasonally and include base camping fees and additional fees for services like electrical hook-up and firewood.
